description.value:
This advanced temperature and moisture regulation technology was developed on Kasath. You're protected from severe heat, and you can survive for four times as long as normal without water before taking damage.

Activate—Vent 2 (manipulate, water)

Frequency once per day

Effect You release a blast of stored heat and vapor in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15], filling the area with mist that lasts for 1 minute. All creatures within the mist become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Concealed], and all creatures outside the mist become concealed to creatures within it.
